name: Davy Airborne
caption: The promotion's own Heavyweight Champion from at least its 10 July 1995 roster, an aerial specialist who defended the title through the summer before losing it, unattested in this record, ahead of its 18 August ratings.

tenures.source: the promotion's own 10 July 1995 roster and card, its 1 August 1995 tapings recap, and its 21 August 1995 Super Challenge 1 broadcast, in which he is no longer champion

name: Hilton Flames
caption: Billed as the "smooth operator," won the Heavyweight Championship somewhere in this record's own gap between 7 and 18 August 1995 and successfully defended it by countout at Super Challenge 1.

tenures.source: the promotion's own 1 August 1995 tapings recap (as a challenger) through its 21 August 1995 Super Challenge 1 broadcast (as champion)

name: Captain America Rick Dorry
caption: The promotion's own Intercontinental Champion throughout this record, successfully defending the title against the Arabic Animal at Super Challenge 1.

tenures.source: the promotion's own 10 July 1995 roster through its 21 August 1995 Super Challenge 1 broadcast

name: Michael Jones
caption: One half of the Brotherhood, won the vacant NWF Tag Team Championship in a five-team elimination match and retained it through this record's own read window.

tenures.source: the promotion's own 1 August 1995 tapings recap and 4 August 1995 results card

name: Curtis McGriff
caption: One half of the Brotherhood, won the vacant NWF Tag Team Championship in a five-team elimination match and retained it through this record's own read window.
